about: The scenes every registered surface is rendered with (CardLayoutTest on Android, -graphselftest on the Mac); format: ../README.md, 'Layout across surfaces'. Times are seconds relative to now (1800000000, UTC). Readings every 5 min from -days to -age, a triangle wave lo..hi with the given period (integer maths: lo + (hi - lo) * tri / half, tri = k or period - k, k = (t - first) mod period, half = period / 2); the newest one is 'last' with 'rate' (null = the source sent none).

scenes.about: above the default high (180), in range once the user's high is 200 (settings 'high200')
a fresh reading the source sent without a rate (Juggluco direction ""): the 'no trend' ring on every surface, never an arrow derived from earlier readings (the Mac did, 2026-10-21)

settings.about: the phone's 12-hour time: every clock time on every surface (card, hour labels, notification, tile, screen-reader words, Mac) is 12-hour
every part of every treatment kind (the look before Treatments on the graph)
rapid: labels without its point or mute line; carbs: amount without time (the meal label takes the time from nobody: none); notes hidden

scroll.about: Scrolled charts (the app panel and the Mac dropdown, the only surfaces that scroll): each case renders 'scene' with the window's end 'back' s before now and, when zoomed, 'span' s long (else the place's 12 h) through the scrollable surfaces' real entry paths (PanelCard with a ChartScroll; the dropdown's CardView with scrollEnd). Checked on both platforms: the chart is the chart of the visible data alone (the same entry path with every reading and treatment outside the window removed, now = the window's end and the place's time shown = the window's length: % column, y range, distribution dots, hour labels, treatment markers), its y range is the visible readings' (yMin = min(low - 22, veryLow - 6, lowest - 6), yMax = max(high + 40, veryHigh + 8, highest + 8)), the Now pill shows only when scrolled or zoomed, and 'expect' (font-independent: chart (its window), chart.pct, chart.y, chart.window, chart.markers). Scenes: this list first, then the main one.

scenes.about: a two-day swing: the last 12 h stay low (70-185), a day back high (185-300): the y range grows while scrolling back
